meta.title: Hypatia Auto Memory
meta.description: Automatic long-term memory for DSH: logs each session into Hypatia and recalls what matters.

en.advancedHint: Advanced fields (binaries, collector caps, queue tuning) can be edited in Settings → Plugins under this plugin, or under the {ns} entry's config in the profile patch.
en.autoApprove: Auto-approve the agent's own hypatia commands
en.autoApproveHint: Only plain hypatia calls with no pipe, redirect or chaining; this plugin's own writes never take that path. With it off, every retrieval raises an approval prompt. Saving a change restarts the collector to apply it.
en.cascadeHint: Every batch of same-tier summaries is archived into one entry a tier up. Relation distance is how near a new memory must be to an existing one to be worth judging a relationship.
en.description: Auto-memory logs conversation turns into Hypatia and runs background consolidation on a dedicated model route.
en.limitsHint: The input budget caps how much conversation is sent to the model (overflow keeps the most recent content); the output budget must fit the summary plus every work unit — too small and consolidation fails.
en.memoryContentFailed: Unable to read memory content from the shelf: {message}
en.memoryDeferred: Tasks waiting for the session to load
en.memoryEntryEmpty: This entry has no body, or it exceeded the display cap.
en.memoryHint: Diagnostic view: raw msg-* conversation text is not shown here — ask the agent to retrieve it through hypatia. Status is re-read every 5 seconds; the timestamp is when the Host last saw that state change (the first read counts as one), so an unchanged one means nothing new happened. Both counts index the session log's event sequence (tool calls included, not messages), so their difference is what is left to summarise.
en.memoryNoSnapshot: The plugin has not published a status snapshot yet. Enable it, finish a turn, and come back.
en.memoryNoSummaries: This session has produced no summary yet. They appear here once consolidation runs.
en.memoryNoWorkUnits: This session has yielded no work units yet.
en.memorySessionNodeNo: not created (the Host supplied no session summary)
en.memorySummarizeBusy: A consolidation covering the same span is already queued.
en.memorySummarizeDisabled: Consolidation is turned off in the settings.
en.memorySummarizeEmpty: Nothing to summarise: the log is already consolidated.
en.memorySummarizeHint: Consolidate the part of this conversation that has not been summarised yet, without waiting for the thresholds. Once caught up the button is disabled but stays in place, so it need not be rediscovered the next time the session falls behind.
en.memorySummarizeQueued: Queued: events {from}–{to} will be summarised. The summary is written in the background on the plugin's own model route and costs this session no context.
en.memorySummarizeUnavailable: Consolidation is unavailable: this composition mounted no model route for it.
en.memorySummarizeUnknown: That session is no longer in memory, so it cannot be consolidated.
en.memoryTruncated: Content exceeded the display cap: earlier entries or over-long bodies were cut.
en.memoryUnknown: This session has no memory record yet. Logging starts once the first turn ends.
en.modelCatalogPartial: Some providers did not return a model catalog.
en.modelSelectionHint: Choose one or more models and set their priority. The list is read top-down: every consolidation starts on the first route, and each failed attempt degrades to the next one (how many fallbacks a task can reach is bounded by the queue's retry limit). Without a selection, conversations continue logging but consolidation stays idle.
en.readOnly: Read-only: settings document is not writable in this context.
en.reasoningBudgetHint: Reasoning effort is how long the model may think. On "follow the purpose policy", summaries and adjudication ask for no reasoning where the route allows it — both are mechanical transforms, so thinking only spends the output budget — while the archive call keeps the model's own default. Choosing a level explicitly overrides that policy; any level other than off shares the output budget with the answer, so the plugin adds its thinking allowance, and a high level is still worth pairing with a larger output budget. Levels are declared by the model itself, and one it does not declare is dropped at call time with a warning.
en.reasoningDefault: Without one, this route defaults to: {effort}
en.reasoningStale: no longer declared by this route
en.reasoningUnavailable: This route declares no reasoning levels
en.recallPreload: Recall: preload rules & taboos at session start
en.shelfDisconnectedWarning: Shelf {shelf} is registered but not connected; writes will fail.
en.shelfHint: Logging, consolidation and the session-start rules preload all read and write this shelf; when it is not default, each session is told to pass --shelf to its hypatia commands. Saving a change restarts the collector on the new shelf. Progress is kept per shelf, so switching back resumes where that shelf left off; on a new shelf, each session is logged from its start the next time it is active, and consolidated again (model calls). Choices come from hypatia list, read on demand when this page opens.
en.shelfListingFailed: hypatia list failed; the list may be stale: {message}
en.shelfLoadFailed: Unable to load the shelf list.
en.shelfNotListedWarning: hypatia has no shelf named {shelf}; writes will fail until you run hypatia connect <dir> --name {shelf}.
